name: Professor Warren Rice
summary: Professor Warren Rice of Miskatonic University assisted Dr. Armitage in researching Wilbur Whateley's diary and stood beside him in the final incantation atop Sentinel Hill that destroyed the horror.
description: Professor Warren Rice and Dr. Francis Morgan were among the men Armitage had confided his conjectures to; both saw Wilbur Whateley's body on the library floor and later, along with Armitage, tortured their brains in speculation and debate over what to do. On the day of the confrontation, Rice took a metal insect-sprayer from a valise and, from a vantage point above and behind the invisible entity, had an excellent chance of spreading the potent powder that revealed it. He declared afterward that he had wholly lost consciousness for an instant during the incantation, though he did not stumble or fall.

sources.quote: Rice, beside him, took from a valise a metal sprayer of the sort used in combating insects; whilst Morgan uncased the big-game rifle on which he relied despite his colleague's warnings that no material weapon would be of help.
He saw that Rice, from the party's point of vantage above and behind the entity, had an excellent chance of spreading the potent powder with marvelous effect.
Professor Rice declares that he wholly lost consciousness for an instant, though he did not stumble or fall.
